verdict.rationale: ClickUp documents an MCP server and public API for connecting external AI tools, plus Brain² which claims persistent, real-time awareness of tasks/docs/conversations and pulls context from integrated apps (Google Drive, GitHub, Salesforce), supporting some context-preserving handoff between tools. However, this is all first-party marketing/docs with no independent or hands-on verification that context is actually preserved across agent-to-agent or tool-to-tool handoffs, and community feedback focuses on general product quality/performance rather than confirming or denying this specific capability. Missing for 10: independent verification of cross-tool/agent handoff without context loss, concrete technical detail on how 'infinite memory' persists across sessions/tools, and third-party corroboration beyond vendor claims.
